last_commit_summary: Turned the Shed Item List Planner into a Shed Model Builder: a live Three.js 3D shed model (walls, skillion/gable roof, door/window openings, boundary-offset line) built from the same plan and roof-pitch assumptions used by the materials item list, with drag-to-orbit and scroll-to-zoom controls.
blocker: Live Bunnings stock and pricing still require approved partner API credentials before runtime access can be enabled.
